createdFor: the orbit-backend-test capability pack Orbit ships (ADR 0034, 0035)
note: Every backend family operation (orbit.messaging.*, orbit.observe.await, orbit.scheduler.*, orbit.job.*, orbit.worker.observe, orbit.state.read, orbit.fixture.*, orbit.clock.advance, orbit.workload.control, orbit.identity.issue), answered by whichever registered adapter serves the bound resource's transport, plus orbit.schedule.expect. Ships reference adapters: AMQP 0-9-1 and NATS JetStream for messaging, PostgreSQL for state, and the open test-hook protocols a project exposes for its scheduler, clock, workers and synthetic identities. Loaded only for a project whose project.json packs lists orbit-backend-test.
